title: Hom action of the normalized algebraic-closure topology-change counit mate
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended $\ell$-adic norm topology. Schemes are separated and finite type over $k$ and morphisms are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. For a profinite set $S$ put
$$C(S)=\{a\in C(S,\Omega):a(S)\subset F\text{ for some finite intermediate field }\mathbf Q_\ell\subset F\subset\Omega\},\qquad B(S)=C(S,\Omega).$$
Here $C$ is the finite-subextension-valued condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], $B$ uses ALL norm-continuous maps [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], and $c:C\to B$ is inclusion. Put $R_W=p_W^*R$ for every coefficient ring $R$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories of internal module objects and their derived geometric adjunctions [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Let $D^b_c(W,R)$ be the full subcategory of complexes with bounded constructible cohomology, where constructible means finite constant local models on finite constructible locally closed stratifications [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Write $J_W=B_W\otimes^L_{C_W}-$ for the actual K-flat derived extension [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars].

Let $f:Z\to T$ be any morphism, let $L\in D^b_c(Z,C)$, and assume $P=Rf_{*,C}L\in D^b_c(T,C)$. For every $M\in D^b_c(T,C)$ one has $f_C^*M\in D^b_c(Z,C)$. For an arbitrary $V\in D(T,C)$, let
$$\sigma_V:f_B^*J_TV\xrightarrow{\sim}J_Zf_C^*V$$
be the canonical pullback/tensor comparison, normalized on flat-term K-flat representatives by the balanced coequalizer map preserving insertion of the scalar unit [lem-sfb-kflat-scalar-comparison-normalization]. Put $Q=Rf_{*,B}J_ZL$ and define $\chi_L:J_TP\to Q$ to be the adjunct of $J_Z\varepsilon_L\circ\sigma_P$, where $\varepsilon_L:f_C^*P\to L$ is the counit. Postcomposition with this specified map is a bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}_B(J_TM,J_TP)\xrightarrow{\ \chi_L\circ-\ }\operatorname{Hom}_B(J_TM,Q).$$
Precisely, this function equals the composite of the following bijections in the ambient derived categories:
$$\operatorname{Hom}_B(J_TM,J_TP)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_C(M,P)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_C(f_C^*M,L)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_B(J_Zf_C^*M,J_ZL)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_B(J_TM,Q).$$
The first and third are inverse or forward scalar-extension maps on Hom, the second is the $C$-geometric adjunction, and the last is precomposition with $\sigma_M$ followed by the $B$-geometric adjunction. In particular for every $u:M\to P$, this composite sends $J_Tu$ to $\chi_L\circ J_Tu$. The claim imposes neither properness of $f$, constructibility of $Q$, nor flatness of $c$.

proof.text: Apply lem-sfb-internal-scalar-pullback-normalization to the actual inclusion C→B. Its comparison b is PullNormalized. The proved normalized_inverse calculation in the module of lem-sfb-normalized-scalar-restriction-push identifies b.inv with the inverse scalar-adjunction mate of scalarRestrictionPull.inv. The inverse of scalarRestrictionPull is exactly algClTopologyDerivedAction: invert its three canonical whiskered comparison factors. Thus the specified theta is b.inv and is invertible. The section derived-category instances used to instantiate the normalization theorem are the canonical Grothendieck-abelian localizations; they add no hypothesis.

Exact geometric pullback is computed termwise by the canonical leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory comparison. Its boundedness and homology comparison are lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below. Use the existing stratification argument as a proved private helper: pull back the witnessing finite locally closed stratification, use new-unbounded-pullback-finite-constant-local-model on each stratum, and transport along upperStar composition. This argument preserves the exact finite-constant-model notion for arbitrary commutative condensed coefficients. Apply it to every homology object, and use the isomorphism invariance of det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude. This proves f_C^*M bounded constant-model constructible. Finite-type separated schemes over the field are qcqs, including empty schemes.

Apply lem-sfb-constructible-algcl-topology-comparison on T and Z. Compose fully faithful Hom equivalences of the full inclusions and the restricted scalar extension. Their forward maps are exactly J_T.map and J_Z.map. Equiv.ofBijective therefore supplies eT and eZ with the specified forward maps. Compose eT inverse, the inverse C-geometric Hom equivalence, eZ, precomposition with sigma_M, and the B-geometric Hom equivalence; all five functions are equivalences.

For u:M→P use the counit formula of lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection. Functoriality of J_Z and naturality of sigma rewrite sigma_M followed by J_Z(f_C^*(u) followed by epsilon_L) as f_B^*(J_T(u)) followed by sigma_P and J_Z(epsilon_L). Mathlib Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left identifies its B-adjunct with J_T(u) followed by the specified chi. For arbitrary v substitute u=eT.symm(v) and use eT.apply_symm_apply. Hence postcomposition with chi is exactly the composite equivalence of the previous step, giving bijectivity and both displayed formulas without additional hypotheses.
